other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via global feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Applying dataset-wide transformations like frequency encoding or group aggregations on the combined train and test dataset leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline using CatBoost and LightGBM with optimized ensembling and strict out-of-fold target encoding. However, it makes critical errors by computing frequency encodings and group aggregates on a combined train/test dataframe (causing data leakage) and using a randomized split on temporal data instead of a time-based split.
